The producer join path remains before notes/client release, and live producer retention plus host journal guards are unchanged.

residual_frontier: Fresh independent review is still required; no approval, acceptance label or commit is claimed.

Injected interruption boundaries use real filesystem journals but do not certify arbitrary signal delivery at every Python instruction, power-loss survival or exactly-once replay. An unacknowledged uncertain row can exist and be observed after explicit reopening.

Restore attempts close and preserves the origin if cleanup raises; a storage implementation that itself refuses resource release before throwing can still retain resources. Tests establish that the owned JsonlExperienceStore releases explicit descriptors even when wrapper close fails.

For arbitrary clients, a normal close return is the completion contract; failed close with unknown state is retained for retry. Only explicit connected=False is treated as confirmed release after an exception.
No expansion to failed-connect/other constructor cleanup paths; fixes are limited to the three named review findings.
Unbounded joins intentionally retain storage ownership while producers remain alive; permanent producer blockage can delay shutdown.
